title: Ledger scope separation
canonical_summary: The Bootstrap Planning Ledger is durable planning/source state for feature-spec conversations. It is not assistant memory, not Plan Mode, and not canonical Plans prose.
negative_constraints: Do not confuse the ledger with the actual chat memory system.
Do not treat the ledger as canonical product prose.

title: Bootstrap and native incarnations
canonical_summary: Define Bootstrap Ledger now and Native Ledger Service later as two incarnations of the same conceptual standard.

title: Machine-first file format
canonical_summary: Use JSONL append logs plus JSON state projections for bootstrap; Markdown is optional debug export only.
negative_constraints: Do not create another Markdown working_ledger.md as the active format.

title: Progressive disclosure for weak agents
canonical_summary: Lower-quality agents may run end-to-end, so they must use compact operating views and capsules instead of reading the whole ledger/schema/history.
negative_constraints: Do not require agents to read the whole ledger to continue.

title: Shards are cold source/history
canonical_summary: Use shards for exact source/history preservation, recovery, audit, and migration. Do not use shards as the normal operating state.
negative_constraints: Sharding alone must not become the active working interface.

title: Design atoms before obligations
canonical_summary: During feature planning, capture neutral design_atom records; only the compiler converts accepted atoms into PlanUnits or obligations.
negative_constraints: Do not prematurely treat every discussion point as a transfer obligation.

title: Per-turn ledger updates
canonical_summary: After every substantive turn, append an event, upsert records, update open questions/blockers, and rewrite current/handoff projections.

title: Exact detail preservation
canonical_summary: Ledger records must preserve exact field names, examples, negative constraints, compatibility-only tokens, stale/retired tokens, owner hints, and user corrections.

title: Evidence class separation
canonical_summary: Separate source evidence, canonical evidence, process evidence, and governance evidence. Canonical evidence must point only to live non-pipeline Plans docs after compilation.
negative_constraints: Do not point canonical evidence at ledgers, shards, pipeline/process artifacts, or governance bundles.

title: Owner ambiguity handling
canonical_summary: Owner ambiguity is normal. Capture candidate owners, consumer docs, evidence, and adjudication rules; do not ask Jared row-by-row unless a true product decision remains.
negative_constraints: Do not blindly trust queued owner hints as authority.
Do not block on ordinary row-level owner ambiguity.

title: AGENTS trigger surface
canonical_summary: Root AGENTS.md must define trigger phrases and read/write rules so Codex knows how to invoke the ledger workflow.

title: Multiple simultaneous ledgers
canonical_summary: Support multiple simultaneous ledgers through stable ledger_id values and ledger_registry.json.

title: Codex phase/thread model
canonical_summary: Bootstrap use in Mac Codex app will likely use separate threads per phase. Conversational ledger creation usually does not need Goal Mode; compile/audit/migration/seal phases use Goal Mode.

title: Goal prompt length
canonical_summary: Codex Goal prompts must be less than 4,000 characters, so the repo must provide reusable files/skill/context and compact prompts.

title: Create Plan Document System doc
canonical_summary: Add a new canonical plan doc that owns plan-doc layout, PlanUnit standard, governance, validators, and lossless conversion rules.

title: Create Planning Ledger System doc
canonical_summary: Add a new canonical plan doc that owns Bootstrap Ledger, Native Ledger Service, ledger core/profile model, per-turn protocol, operating capsules, and ledger-to-plan compilation.

title: Create Plan-to-Node Compilation doc
canonical_summary: Add an interface doc for PlanUnit -> NodeSeed -> WorkNode conversion, including ordering, complexity, validation, and capability metadata.

title: Create Bootstrap Planning Migration doc
canonical_summary: Add a migration doc for using the bootstrap system now, converting existing Plans losslessly, and transitioning to native services later.

title: Plan docs standardized but not rigid
canonical_summary: Use a base required layout plus doc-type modules, not a forced identical skeleton for every existing plan doc.
negative_constraints: Do not force all existing Plans into a rigid identical layout in one unsafe pass.

title: Lossless Plan conversion protocol
canonical_summary: Existing Plans must be converted losslessly with pre-hash, heading/body span inventory, coverage mapping, anchor/alias preservation, ContractRef preservation, and validators.

title: PlanUnit as canonical bridge
canonical_summary: Every meaningful canonical requirement/decision/constraint/validation rule should become or map to a stable PlanUnit.

title: PlanUnit node-readiness fields
canonical_summary: PlanUnits must expose dependencies, unblocks, implementation surfaces, acceptance criteria, validation surfaces, risk, reasoning tier, context scope, and node compile hints.

title: No final WorkNodes in Plans
canonical_summary: Plan docs must not contain final executable WorkNodes. Work nodes are execution strategy; Plans contain stable PlanUnits and compilation hints.
negative_constraints: Do not put final WorkNodes directly inside canonical plan docs.

title: Plan-to-node ordering
canonical_summary: The WorkNode compiler needs build order, dependencies, blockers, unblocks, parallelism, validation dependencies, and governance dependencies.

title: Capability not hardcoded model names
canonical_summary: Plans should expose capability/risk fields; runtime maps them to actual LLM/model choices later.
negative_constraints: Do not hardcode model names such as a specific GPT model into PlanUnits as canonical execution policy.

title: Generated PlanUnit index
canonical_summary: Standardized Plans should generate indexes under Plans/.plan_index/ for plan_units, doc cards, dependencies, acceptance units, coverage reports, and node-readiness reports. This phase must not create WorkNodes.
negative_constraints: Do not create WorkNodes from the PlanUnit index phase.

title: Spec Lock seal timing
canonical_summary: Do not update Spec Lock, generated shards, evidence bundles, plan graph, or governance locks until the final governance seal phase after docs/indexes stop changing.
negative_constraints: Do not update Spec Lock during ordinary ledger writing, plan drafting, or plan conversion batches.

title: Retired experiments excluded
canonical_summary: Retired prompt-packet/tranche/subagent conversion experiments are not architecture for the new system. Use Goal + new ledger + validators + compact views instead.
exact_tokens: Goal + Ledger + Validators + Compact Operating Views
negative_constraints: Do not reference retired packet/tranche mechanics as the basis of the new architecture.

title: Native Chain Wizard Goal integration
canonical_summary: Future Chain Wizard should use native Goal Mode invisibly to transfer ledgers to Plans, convert Plans to work nodes, and audit. Assistant chat can invoke Goal Mode visibly for arbitrary execution tasks.
gui_classification_reason: Goal/compilation integration rule; not itself GUI implementation work.

title: Plan-to-node detailed algorithm deferred
canonical_summary: The exact PlanUnit-to-NodeSeed-to-WorkNode compiler algorithm remains deferred. Current work should produce only PlanUnit indexes and node-readiness reports until the compiler contract exists.
negative_constraints: Do not generate NodeSeeds or WorkNodes before the Plan_To_Node_Compilation contract is complete.

title: PlanUnit index is not WorkNode creation
canonical_summary: Generating the PlanUnit index and node-readiness report must not create WorkNodes or executable build tasks. It may only catalog canonical PlanUnits and assess future node-conversion readiness.
negative_constraints: Do not create WorkNodes or executable build tasks during PlanUnit indexing.
Do not generate NodeSeed candidates unless the Plan_To_Node_Compilation contract explicitly defines that candidate artifact.
gui_classification_reason: Compiler/readiness boundary rule; not GUI implementation work.

title: Automatic gui_related classification
canonical_summary: Agents must automatically classify each design atom and PlanUnit with a simple gui_related boolean. The user does not need to identify GUI/UI/icon/image work during conversation.
negative_constraints: Do not require the user to declare whether an item is GUI-related.
Do not use a granular surface taxonomy for the bootstrap standard; use a simple boolean.
gui_classification_reason: Metadata/classification rule; not itself GUI implementation work.

title: Native GUI model routing setting
canonical_summary: Native Puppet Master should expose a simple setting such as “use different model for GUI elements?” so gui_related work can route to the configured GUI model when enabled.
exact_tokens: use different model for GUI elements?
negative_constraints: Do not expose a highly granular GUI/UI/icon/image routing taxonomy in the product UI.
gui_classification_reason: This PlanUnit will likely involve a user-visible settings/control surface.

title: Future router inherits gui_related
canonical_summary: Future NodeSeeds and WorkNodes must inherit gui_related from source PlanUnits. If gui_related is true and separate GUI model routing is enabled, the bootstrap/native orchestrator routes the task to the configured GUI-capable model or CLI; otherwise it uses the default model.
negative_constraints: Do not hardcode Antigravity, Cursor, or any specific model name into canonical PlanUnits as the only routing option.
gui_classification_reason: Backend/orchestration routing rule; not GUI authoring work itself.
